name: @stagetheproindia/react-rewardrally
description: Ultimate Gamification for your React app.

scripts.open-android: cd demo-ionic && ionic build && npx cap sync && npx cap open android && cd ..
scripts.run-android: cd demo-ionic && ionic build && npx cap sync && npx cap run android && cd ..
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build-js
scripts.build-js: npm run copy-package-json && npm run build-js-esm && npm run build-js-cjs
scripts.build-js-esm: npm run copy-images && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json --outDir ./dist/esm --module esnext
scripts.build-js-cjs: npm run copy-images && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json --outDir ./dist/cjs --module commonjs
scripts.copy-images: echo Copying images...  && copyfiles -f  ./src/**/**/*.{png,jpg,svg} ./dist/esm/common/images && copyfiles -f ./src/**/**/*.{png,jpg,svg} ./dist/cjs/common/images && echo Images copied.
scripts.prepack: npm run clean && npm run build
